test_run_glue_on_tpu: test the TorchXLAExamplesTests.test_run_glue method to run GLUE text classification on TPU with xla_spawn
test_trainer_tpu: test the TorchXLAExamplesTests.test_trainer_tpu method to run trainer tests on TPU with xla_spawn
get_results_from_output_dir: get results from all_results.json in the given output directory
run_xla_spawn_main: run xla_spawn.main() to launch distributed PyTorch-XLA training across multiple TPU cores
require_torch_xla_decorator: use the require_torch_xla decorator to skip tests when PyTorch-XLA is not available
